critique.evidence: Keyboard coverage is complete with visible focus for all expected controls at every viewport; no touch-target violations, uncontained viewport overflow, automated WCAG violations, or reduced-motion element changes were measured. However, color contrast remains unresolved: serious incomplete checks affect 10 Atlas nodes on desktop, including all eight flow nodes and both status badges, plus header links on tablet/mobile. Large horizontally clipped Atlas grids and header navigation are contained, but no assistive-technology usability proof is provided for discovering and operating that off-screen content.
critique.fix: Measure and correct contrast for every unresolved node against its actual composited background, then verify the horizontally scrollable Atlas board and header with a screen reader and keyboard at mobile/tablet widths, including clear scroll-region instructions and reliable focus-driven scrolling.
